title: Uniform approximation by perfect complexes with closed support
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Say that $\mathsf A(Y)$ holds if the following condition holds. For every closed subset $T\subseteq Y$ whose open complement is retrocompact in $Y$ (that is, $(Y\setminus T)\cap W$ is quasi-compact for every affine open $W\subseteq Y$), there exists $r\in\mathbf Z$ such that, for every $m\in\mathbf Z$ and $F\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Y)$ [def-pc-derived-category] which is $(m-r)$-pseudo-coherent [def-sfb-m-pseudo-coherent-complex] and satisfies $H^i(F)_y=0$ for every $i\ge m-r$ and every $y\notin T$, there exist a perfect object $P\in D(\mathcal O_Y)$ [def-pc-perfect-complex] and a morphism $v:P\to F$ such that $H^i(P)_y=0$ for every $i\in\mathbf Z$ and every $y\notin T$, $H^i(v)$ is an isomorphism for every $i>m$, and $H^m(v)$ is surjective. Thus support is a condition on all cohomology stalks, and the integer $r$ may depend on $Y,T$ but not on $F,m$.
